description: Agent cost pilot cases: 4 research, 2 analytics, 2 content, 2 finance. Research queries are golden dataset queries, copied verbatim.

cases.query: Summarize why CRISPR-Cas9 experiments need off-target analysis.
What factors contributed to the reproducibility crisis in psychology?
Compare demographic parity and equalized odds fairness metrics.
Analyze what a 12-month subscription churn series rising from 2% to 3.5% per month implies for revenue growth, and which metrics to track next.
Explain how to test whether a website redesign changed conversion rate, given 40,000 sessions before and 38,000 after.
Draft a 300-word launch announcement for a privacy-preserving analytics feature, aimed at engineering managers.
Write a plain-language explainer, for a general audience, on how public key cryptography protects online banking.
Assess the liquidity and leverage of a company with current assets of 120, current liabilities of 80, total debt of 200 and equity of 150 (USD millions).
Evaluate the main risks of holding a 60/40 equity and bond portfolio when inflation stays above 4 percent.
